body:
Why is this needed for your project? Historically, we've been explicit on casting vectors.

Can you write a proposal for this enhancement?
* Also see: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109687#issuecomment-3194482985 for the same test results using constructors instead of static method.

> Why not for `Vector4(i)`

I didn’t add it because I couldn’t find any use cases for it in the Godot source at the time. Of course, if you think it would be useful, it can definitely be added, I just wanted to avoid introducing extra API that might not get used.
I think it would be the most useful there and it'd be very confusing to have it in two but not the third

* Closing in favor of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109687, which already has an associated proposal: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3884.

* We can revisit this if a new proposal is made. For now, I think it’s better to stick with constructors since they’re faster in `GDScript` and avoid extra static methods that mostly make the code longer. The static version only showed benefits when eliminating temporary variables.

* If someone can show that it performs just as well as using the constructor directly, we can reconsider after running performance comparisons in both C++ and `GDScript`, with and without optimized builds.
Can be optionally implemented later after https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/110743.
